'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Joe Orthner DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Orthner]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Court of the Vile Bubo'''. Username '''Grawaine'''. Handwritten. DARK checked. Line 1 is Prepared Defenses; the starting objective is line 5 (no start circle). Written Great Pit, Audience Chamber, Lat Damage, Hidden Weps, Barrier, Dengar in P1, CC East Landing Platform. Line 28 is a struck name then P-59 (struck name not entered). Line 58 is struck; the additional-cards line reads #58 → Special Delivery and that box is checked, so line 58 is Special Delivery (V). Shield line 12 is blank. A margin note beside Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter reads No V; that box is empty.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster]]
* '''Username:''' Grawaine
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
